recipes.name: Pimm's Cup
recipes.method: Fill a tall glass with ice and the fruit. Add the Pimm's, top up with lemonade and stir gently. Finish with the mint.

recipes.name: Gin and tonic
recipes.method: Fill a tall glass with ice. Pour in the gin, then the tonic down a bar spoon so it keeps its fizz. Squeeze the lime over and drop it in.

recipes.name: Bramble
recipes.method: Fill a short glass with crushed ice. Add the gin, lemon and syrup and stir. Pile on more crushed ice, then drizzle the crème de mûre over the top. Garnish with a blackberry.

recipes.name: Shandy
recipes.method: Tilt a pint glass and pour in the beer, then top up with the lemonade. No stirring: it mixes as it pours.

recipes.name: Sloe gin fizz
recipes.method: Shake the sloe gin, lemon and syrup hard with ice. Strain into a tall glass over fresh ice and top up with soda.
